name: @hivemagnus/magnus
description: Install, upgrade and roll back a Magnus server and console with one command: `npx @hivemagnus/magnus init`, then `magnus upgrade`. Pins exact, tested component versions, backs up PostgreSQL before every migration and reverts automatically when the new version fails its health check.
author: ChefTaco

newOptionalEnv.name: MAGNUS_TRUSTED_PROXIES
newOptionalEnv.description: Comma-separated proxies whose X-Forwarded-For the rate limiter believes: IP addresses, CIDR ranges and the presets loopback, private and linklocal, read from the right past every trusted hop. Unset: the socket peer is the client. An invalid entry is refused at startup.

magnusRelease.summary: The server adopts @hivemagnus/hive-common 0.11.1. Optional MAGNUS_TRUSTED_PROXIES names the proxies whose X-Forwarded-For the rate limiter believes (unset: the socket peer). Inbound request IDs are validated (1-128 safe characters, otherwise a generated UUID). Hive IAM mode (IAM_CORE_URL) is deprecated for removal in 4.0.0 and its tokens now need a jti and an exact single audience. When Redis is unavailable, rate limits that are not fail-closed fall back to a per-process limiter with the same budget instead of none. Redaction keeps a secret's name while masking its value. Ardent stays 3.6.0. No migration.
